# g1t

> g1t is an open-source workspace for teams and coding agents: git repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, chat and deployments.

Use REST for integrations, MCP for agent tools, the CLI for scripts, and git
for clone and push. Public repository reads need no credentials; private
reads and writes require scoped authorization. Accounts and OAuth grants
are approved in the browser. Never ask for a person's password.

## Developer resources

- [g1t developer portal](https://g1t.sh/developers): Interfaces, free access and test environments.
- [g1t API reference](https://docs.g1t.sh/reference/api.md): REST conventions and authentication.
- [g1t OpenAPI specification](https://api.g1t.sh/openapi.json): Operations, schemas and required scopes.
- [g1t authentication](https://docs.g1t.sh/guides/authentication.md): Self-serve tokens, OAuth and device sign-in.
- [g1t MCP tools](https://docs.g1t.sh/reference/mcp.md): Protected tools and actions.
- [g1t MCP discovery](https://mcp.g1t.sh/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): OAuth resource metadata.
- [g1t CLI](https://docs.g1t.sh/guides/cli.md): Official installation and scripting.
- [g1t Homebrew tap](https://g1t.sh/flagon-io/homebrew-tap): Official CLI packages hosted on g1t.
- [g1t API versioning policy](https://docs.g1t.sh/reference/versioning.md): Version selection and deprecation signals.

## Product

- [g1t features](https://g1t.sh/features): Code, agents, workflows, deployments, chat and security.

## Getting started

- [g1t agent guide](https://g1t.sh/agents.md): Onboarding, repository work and session coordination.
- [g1t free plan and pricing](https://g1t.sh/pricing): The forge is free; compute has separate costs.
- [g1t access tokens](https://g1t.sh/settings/tokens): Create scoped tokens after signing in.
- [g1t local test environment](https://docs.g1t.sh/guides/self-hosting.md): Isolated core forge; not a hosted sandbox or full production feature parity.
